components.name: proposition
values: crop-seq identifies known activators lck zap70 lat and repressors ptpn6 ptpn11 egr3 of tcr signaling in jurkat cells validated by bulk rna-seq and flow cytometry.

components.name: proposition
values: the cropseq-guide-puro vector does not compromise lentiviral function or genome editing efficiency compared to the standard lentiguide-puro vector.

components.name: proposition
values: crop-seq enables pooled crispr screens with single-cell transcriptome readout by engineering a grna vector that makes individual grnas detectable in single-cell rna-seq and combining it with a high-throughput single-cell rna-seq assay.

components.name: proposition
values: crop-seq can derive gene signatures directly from single-cell data using transcriptomes of cells with nontargeting grnas making the assay self-calibrating and independent of prior knowledge.

components.name: observation
values: grnas targeting ets1 runx1 and gata3 were depleted suggesting that the encoded transcription factors are essential in jurkat cells. in contrast most grnas behaved similarly to the negative controls indicating that they did not have strong antiproliferative effects.

components.name: observation
values: 38.7% of cells with at least 500 and 78.9% of cells with at least 4 000 detected genes were uniquely assigned. few cells matched more than one grna e.g. 2.7% for a threshold of 500 detected genes .

components.name: observation
values: cloning the hu6-grna cassette into the 3ʹ ltr to generate cropseq-guide-puro does not compromise lentiviral function for grnas. in contrast 1 885 bp of filler dna result in a 98-fold reduction of the viral titer.

components.name: observation
values: when we applied drop-seq on a 1 1 1 mixture of the three cell lines the resulting single-cell transcriptomes provided high sequencing coverage for the grnas and we were able to assign single cells to grnas at the expected ratios.

components.name: observation
values: genome editing was highly efficient for both constructs averaging at 95.5% lentiguide-puro and 90.5% cropseq-guide-puro with the expected two thirds 66.2% and 62.4% of molecules carrying out-of-frame insertions and deletions.

components.name: observation
values: 870 single cells 15% of the data set yielded results similar to those of the entire screen regarding the tcr signature intensities of the targeted genes.

components.name: observation
values: high correlations were observed between bulk rna-seq and crop-seq data both for inferred tcr signature intensities and for global expression profiles pearson s r = 0.97 for signature intensity . flow cytometry for surface proteins further validated the crop-seq results pearson s r = 0.93 for cd69 .

components.name: observation
values: depletion of the kinases lck and zap70 and the adaptor protein lat had a strong negative effect on the tcr activation signature. targeting known negative regulators of tcr signaling such as ptpn6 ptpn11 and egr3 slightly increased the tcr activation signature.

components.name: observation
values: principal component analysis for cells grouped by grna target genes separated naive and tcr-induced jurkat cells along the first principal component which defined a tcr induction signature of 165 genes.

components.name: method
values: arrayed validation | 48 individual cropseq-guide-puro constructs were cloned targeting 20 genes with two grnas each plus 8 nontargeting controls. lentivirus produced in 96-well plates. jurkat-cas9 cells transduced and selected. after 10 days cells were split for starvation/stimulation as above. rna extracted for bulk rna-seq illumina and cells stained for flow cytometry cd25 cd38 cd69 cd82 cd154 pd-1 ki-67 .

tcr stimulation and crop-seq | jurkat-cas9 cells were serum starved for 3 h then stimulated with 1 ug/ml anti-cd3 and 1 ug/ml anti-cd28 antibodies for 4 h. unstimulated control underwent continued starvation. single-cell rna-seq performed using drop-seq with crop-seq modifications.

components.name: name
values: proof-of-concept tcr screen in jurkat cells

components.name: task
values: pooled crispr screen targeting 6 high-level regulators of tcr signaling and 23 transcription factors three grnas each plus 20 nontargeting controls and 9 essential gene controls
serum starvation for 3 h then tcr stimulation with anti-cd3/anti-cd28 for 4 h unstimulated control continued starvation
transduction of cas9-expressing jurkat cells with lentiviral grna library puromycin selection genome editing for 10 days
validation by arrayed screen 48 constructs 20 genes with two grnas with bulk rna-seq 87 libraries and flow cytometry 96 profiles

components.name: method
values: crop-seq data preprocessing | drop-seq tools v1.12 was used read2 tagged with cell barcode bases 1-12 and umi bases 13-20 trimmed aligned with star to human genome grch38 extended with artificial chromosomes representing the cropseq-guide-puro plasmid. cell barcodes corrected for synthesis errors. umi-deduplicated reads per gene per cell used to build digital expression matrix cells with 500 genes . grna assigned as most abundant umi-deduplicated read overlapping grna sequence cells with >0.9 purity retained for jurkat screen.

crop-seq library construction | insertion of hu6-grna cassette into the 3 ltr of lentiguide-puro via ligase cycling reaction. the cassette is transcribed by pol ii as part of the puromycin-resistance mrna detectable by poly-a enrichment in single-cell rna-seq. grna is also expressed from the hu6 pol iii promoter for genome editing.

drop-seq single-cell rna-seq | cells were co-encapsulated with barcoded beads in microfluidic droplets. after droplet breakage with perfluoroctanol beads were collected by syringe filtration. reverse transcription exonuclease i treatment pcr enrichment 4+10 cycles and nextera xt library preparation were performed. sequencing on illumina hiseq 3000/4000 or nextseq 500.

lentivirus production and titration | hek293t cells were co-transfected with cropseq-guide-puro and packaging plasmids pmdlg/prre prsv-rev pmd2.g . supernatant collected at 24 and 48 h filtered and titrated on hek293t cells with puromycin selection. titer calculated from resistant colony counts.

components.name: task
values: assessment of grna assignment confidence across crop-seq experiments
construct design insertion of hu6-grna cassette into 3 ltr of lentiguide-puro to create cropseq-guide-puro
detection of grnas from single-cell transcriptomes by drop-seq on a 1 1 1 mixture of hek293t knockout cell lines dnmt3b mbd1 tet2
genome editing efficiency comparison using t7 endonuclease assay and ngs in k562 jurkat and hek293t cells
viral titer comparison between lentiguide-puro and cropseq-guide-puro for three grnas and a filler construct
